This typically means triggering a rolling update of the Deployment. Since the image tag is already correct in the deployment definition (it points to the "stable" tag), simply forcing a rollout should cause the Deployment to pull the latest image from the registry associated with that tag and start new pods.

1.  Identify the relevant Deployment.

3.  Verify that new pods are running with the updated image and that the desired state is achieved.

I will start by listing deployments to find the target.
